Risk Title & Description: Synthetic Identity & Spoofing Bypass: Fraudsters use altered IDs, deepfakes, or synthetic PII to open deposit accounts online during promotional campaigns.
Mapped Control / Framework: NIST CSF 2.0 PR.AA / DE.CM; GLBA Safeguards
Mitigating Controls: Liveness checks, document tamper detection, velocity/device risk rules, and manual step-up review for high-risk signals.

Risk Title & Description: Unapproved Sub-Processor Chain: Third-party IDV vendor routes ID images or biometrics to sub-contractors or overseas cloud regions without explicit bank approval.
Mapped Control / Framework: NIST CSF 2.0 GV.SC; GLBA Third-Party Oversight
Mitigating Controls: Require sub-processor disclosure list, contractual approval prior to onboarding new sub-processors, and annual vendor review.

Risk Title & Description: Excessive Retention of Sensitive PII & Biometrics: Raw ID scans, selfies, and SSN data remain stored in vendor/bank buckets longer than needed for compliance or dispute handling.
Mapped Control / Framework: NIST CSF 2.0 PR.DS; GLBA Data Minimization
Mitigating Controls: Define formal data retention and automated deletion schedules; encrypt data at rest and in transit; restrict bucket access.

Risk Title & Description: Weak API & Webhook Authentication: Onboarding status callbacks or document upload APIs lack strong token validation, rate limiting, or mutual TLS/signed payloads.
Mapped Control / Framework: NIST CSF 2.0 PR.AA / PR.PT; OWASP API Security
Mitigating Controls: Enforce strong API authentication, HMAC webhook signature verification, IP allowlisting, and rate limiting.

Risk Title & Description: Unclear Incident & Breach Notification SLA: Vendor agreement does not specify rapid security incident reporting timelines or forensic cooperation expectations.
Mapped Control / Framework: NIST CSF 2.0 GV.SC / RS.MA; Bank TPRM Policy
Mitigating Controls: Add mandatory breach notification SLA (e.g., within 24-36 hours of confirmation) and incident cooperation clauses in contract.
